title: Before you travel
description: Quick checks before leaving with your laptop.

items.text: Make sure your backup ran recently
items.hint: Open the Backup screen in PC Helper. The last backup should be from the past day or two.
Click Start → Settings → Windows Update. Install anything waiting — so you're not interrupted on the road.
Check you have the right charger for your laptop — they're not all the same.
Hotels and airports have their own Wi-Fi. Your phone can also be a hotspot if needed.

items.text: Check the Password Vault is locked
items.hint: Open the Vault in PC Helper and make sure it's locked before you leave.
